capabilities: Displays an animated pixel cat on the workspace
Tracks writing toward daily word or character goals
Runs focus sessions and Pomodoro rounds with breaks
Keeps an internal to-do list and daily quests
Awards XP, coins, badges and costumes
extras: Desktop only; no network access; optional Pretendard font; daily data backup and cross-device merge; in-game 'premium' dishes use earned coins, not real money; unofficial fan-made project not affiliated with Anthropic or Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian gives no playful, visible reward for daily writing, task completion and focus sessions, so building note habits can feel like a chore.

relations.evidence: Vault Pet is the Obsidian edition of the Kit Commit desktop pet.
Using Hearth? Its Vault Pet card puts your cat, or its whole house, on your Hearth dashboard.

summary: Pixel cat desktop pet that turns writing, task completion and focus sessions into XP, coins, levels, quests and collectible costumes.
